mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversations (type, assistant_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{type}, #{assistantCode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, type, assistant_code, last_message_id, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at FROM conversations WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT conversation_id, type, assistant_code, last_message_id, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at FROM conversations WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.conversation_id FROM conversations c INNER JOIN conversation_participants cp1 ON cp1.conversation_id = c.conversation_id INNER JOIN conversation_participants cp2 ON cp2.conversation_id = c.conversation_id WHERE c.type = 'USER_DIRECT' AND cp1.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND cp2.user_id = #{targetUserId} LIMIT 1

select c.conversation_id from conversations c inner join conversation_participants cp on cp.conversation_id = c.conversation_id where cp.user_id = #{currentUserId} and c.type = 'USER_AI' and c.assistant_code = #{assistantCode} order by c.created_at asc limit 1
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations c SET last_message_id = m_new.message_id, last_message_at = m_new.created_at, updated_at = NOW() FROM messages m_new WHERE c.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m_new.message_id = #{lastMessageId} AND m_new.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND ( c.last_message_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM messages m_old WHERE m_old.message_id = c.last_message_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM messages m_old WHERE m_old.message_id = c.last_message_id AND ( m_new.created_at > m_old.created_at OR ( m_new.created_at = m_old.created_at AND m_new.message_id > m_old.message_id ) ) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id, u.user_id AS other_user_id, u.username AS other_user_name, u.avatar_url AS other_user_avatar_url, m.message_id AS last_message_id, m.content AS last_message_content, c.last_message_at AS last_message_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages mx LEFT JOIN messages lr ON lr.message_id = cp_self.last_read_message_id WHERE mx.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND mx.sender_user_id != #{currentUserId} AND ( cp_self.last_read_message_id IS NULL OR mx.created_at > lr.created_at ) ) AS unread_count FROM conversations c INNER JOIN conversation_participants cp_self ON cp_self.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND cp_self.user_id = #{currentUserId} INNER JOIN conversation_participants cp_other ON cp_other.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND cp_other.user_id != #{currentUserId} INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = cp_other.user_id LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.message_id = c.last_message_id -- WHERE c.type = 'DIRECT' ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC, c.conversation_id DESC
